title: 📝 Microsoft's Copilot Pages Is Now for Everyone: A Space Where You Write With AI!
body: 📝 Microsoft's Copilot Pages Is Now for Everyone: A Space Where You Write With AI!

Microsoft has expanded its Copilot Pages feature to reach all signed-in users around the world, after it was exclusive to business subscribers since its launch in September 2024 as part of the Microsoft 365 Copilot package.

Pages is a new collaborative space: instead of a passing chat with the smart assistant that ends when you close the window, you get a permanent page where you and the assistant work together to edit and create content, whether it is text, a document, or a creative project. Several people can work in the same space at the same time, so the assistant writes a draft, the human reviews it, and the assistant rewrites it, without needing to copy and paste text between windows.

The step means that tools for working together with AI are no longer a privilege for big companies, but are now available to any user with an account, at a time when companies are racing to turn the smart assistant from a side chat into a real work partner.

Simply put: the smart assistant no longer answers and then forgets, but has become a colleague who writes with you on the same page; so would you prefer AI to work beside you in a shared space, or should writing remain purely human work?
